availability_note: Same Sootopolis party (Rillaboom 36, Kartana 20, Raging Bolt 60, Flutter Mane 68, Incineroar 36, Zapdos 30 reachable legend); Sootopolis after the cavern and Cave of Origin, Rain Badge not earned, nothing from Ever Grande or the League.

attempts.note: T1 Grassy Glide fired Carracosta's Weakness Policy and Leaf Blade finished it the same turn; Araquanid's Leech Life did 259 to Rillaboom. T2 Rillaboom lost a speed tie to Cramorant's Ice Beam and fainted before U-turn; Araquanid Protect. T3 Clawitzer switched in for Araquanid and was OHKOed by a +1 Leaf Blade; Cramorant Protect. T4 Hurricane broke Kartana's Sash and confused it; Thunderbolt (4x) took Cramorant. T5 Blastoise switched in for Araquanid (un-Mega'd) and was OHKOed by Thunderbolt. T6-T7 Araquanid Protect then Liquidation; Thunderbolt took it. T8 Tentacruel's second Protect failed and Thunderbolt + Knock Off ended it.

strategy_checks.check: Carracosta Shell Smash only behind Araquanid's Wide Guard / attack; Weakness Policy fires on a super-effective hit
strategy_checks.evidence: T1 chose Aqua Jet (not Smash, correct with two Grass foes across); Grassy Glide triggered the Policy (+2/+2 shown) and Leaf Blade KOed it in the same turn through Solid Rock.

strategy_checks.check: Araquanid Water Bubble Liquidation / Leech Life / Wide Guard front
strategy_checks.evidence: T1 Leech Life 259 on an Assault Vest Rillaboom; Protect on T2/T4/T6 each blocked a super-effective hit (three real Protects); T7 Liquidation 38 on a resisting Raging Bolt. It never used Wide Guard because I never used a spread move.

It chose Ice Beam (KO on Rillaboom), Protect and Hurricane (Sash break + confusion) and never Surfed, so no catch was ever held; a 4x Thunderbolt took it. Sensible clicks, but the signature never appeared.
I never drained (crack line). It used Muddy Water (114 on Incineroar) and Protect twice, the second failing.
AI switched it in for Araquanid on T3 directly into a +1 Leaf Blade and it fainted without a move.
T5 the AI switched Blastoise in for Araquanid as a receiver in front of Raging Bolt; it took a 2x Thunderbolt un-Mega'd and fainted without a move.

protect_ledger.payoff: REAL - blocked a +1 Leaf Blade; Cramorant KOed Rillaboom beside it.
REAL - blocked a +2 Leaf Blade; Cramorant's Hurricane broke Kartana's Sash.
EMPTY - nothing targeted it; partner slot was a Blastoise sack.
REAL - blocked Thunderbolt + Knock Off; Tentacruel's Muddy Water hit both.
REAL (redirect) - Knock Off redirected into it after Araquanid fainted.
FAILED - consecutive Protect failed, last member.

ai_defects.chosen: switch Araquanid out into Clawitzer (T3), then into Blastoise (T5)
ai_defects.better: Both receivers were frail special attackers with 4 HP EVs fed into a visible Grass or Electric attacker; the Mega closer in particular should never be the sack. Araquanid itself was the bulkiest body and had Protect. Medium severity: it cost the room its Specs cannon and its Mega without either moving.

authored_set_legality: No problem found. Levels L84 x5, Blastoise L85.
theme_note: Half. The Policy gamble fired visibly and Araquanid's Water Bubble bite was the biggest hit I took in the gym, but the two artillery pieces (Clawitzer, Mega Blastoise) and the Gulp Missile signature never happened - two of them because the AI used them as switch fodder.

level_changes.reason: first-try win with one faint (speed-tie loss) and no real threat; Carracosta died on T1 before its boost could act.
fainted on the switch-in turn without acting; Araquanid/Cramorant did the room's work and Blastoise is the Mega.

level_changes_unverified: Not re-run: build-8 ROM predates these offsets; rerun after the main agent rebuilds.
cooler: The pieces are good; the AI's switch logic undercuts them. Worth checking on the AI side: the switch-receiver choice picks the frailest reserve (Clawitzer, then the un-Mega'd Blastoise) into an obvious super-effective attacker. On the set side, Cramorant needs a reason to click Surf over Ice Beam/Hurricane when the catch is its whole point. Not changed in this pass.
most_worth_rerunning: Rerun with a non-Grass lead to see whether Cramorant Surfs and whether the AI still sacks Blastoise.
